verdict.rationale: First-party docs show notes can be exported to Google Docs or Google Sheets, slide decks shared as PDF, flashcards downloaded as CSV, and infographics as PNG, which covers the document and spreadsheet parts of the story. Nothing in the pack shows export to reference-manager formats such as BibTeX or RIS. Missing for 10: reference-manager file export (BibTeX/RIS/Zotero), export to non-Google document formats like DOCX, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the export features.
